status: Frozen before any full neural held-out-site prediction.

training.loss: binary cross entropy with fitting-partition negative/positive class ratio as pos_weight

tuning.candidate_score: unweighted mean per-site balanced accuracy across all inner validation sites and both tuning seeds
tuning.selected_final_epoch: ceiling of the median one-based best epoch across the 4 inner folds and 2 tuning seeds

final_fit.held_out_site_use: one probability-generating evaluation per final seed after fitting

preprocessing.feature_scaling: mean and standard deviation fitted only on the active fitting partition over participant and node dimensions

run_control.retry_policy: Retry only infrastructure interruption from the latest verified checkpoint. Non-finite loss, invalid gradient, or contract mismatch fails the cell and the site; no silent hyperparameter substitution.
run_control.results_embargo: No neural held-out prediction or metric may be read before the complete score-blind artifact audit passes.
